scenario: Integer literal at the INT64_MIN boundary (-2^63 = -9223372036854775808) compiles cleanly per LGRA.2.7.3. The lexer tokenises the positive magnitude 9223372036854775808 (one past INT64_MAX) before unary minus applies, so it is admitted as a literal only when negated; `-9223372036854775808` folds to a valid INT64_MIN. A bare 9223372036854775808 is still a range error (see LGRA.2.7.3_min_bare).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v > -9223372036854775808
->
    log info "x"
